title: Serve European task-345 LZ77 inputs through the cartridge bus
platforms: European ROM, Windows harness under Wine
changes: Serve the 13 memory-bound encoded inputs through the ordinary cartridge bus, with exact bounds and composition with neighboring control and ROM data.
Validate bound input pages during activation and report bus-served input bytes separately from HLE decoding.
validation: Windows harness rvt7j7za built successfully. Wine c5hp1xyf matched direct byte and native ABI reads for all 15 inputs across three mirrors with inverted backing.
DMA3 halfword and word copies across a bound and raw boundary match destination, channel control and guest clock. The 300-frame slot-1 replay matches E473, including its state digest.
The Wine runner drained the server, preserved 35 input paths and retired scratch.
limitations: The authenticated ROM supplies the in-memory bindings at activation. Persistent coverage, translated guest scenes, additional ordinary selectors, Linux and USA remain open.
